name: 注入登录态
source: localStorage.setItem('mediaflow.token', '<登录后用 API 取得的 accessToken>');localStorage.setItem('mediaflow.refreshToken', '<refreshToken>');

name: 关键元素
js: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-testid=workspace-lifecycle]'); return { url: location.href, card: !!card, status: document.querySelector('[data-testid=lifecycle-status]')?.textContent, exportPanel: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=workspace-export-panel]'), exportNotice: document.body.innerText.includes('导出产物将在 7 天后自动删除'), buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12) }; })()

name: 打开删除确认框
js: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='删除工作区'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

name: 确认框关键元素
js: (() => { return { dialog: !!document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'), warning: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=last-workspace-warning]'), checkbox: !!document.querySelector('[data-testid=last-workspace-ack] input'), exitNote: document.querySelector('[data-testid=purge-exit-note]')?.textContent?.trim(), confirmDisabled: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('确认删除'))?.disabled }; })()

name: 打开归档确认框
js: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('归档工作区')); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
